The passages do not explicitly address delayed disclosure of alignment research findings. The closest proposal is to **support external alignment research and independent scrutiny through selective diffusion and “structured access” to AI research artifacts**—for example, giving a trusted alignment organization access to a compute cluster or a leading developer’s pretrained model. (https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/suBJdDkEu9EaSmTxJ/implications-of-large-language-model-diffusion-for-ai)

The mechanism is to give outside researchers resources for alignment research and make it easier for more actors to scrutinize leading developers’ work. However, this is not an explicit proposal requiring timely publication of alignment findings. (https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/oB3MnFQa8LqcuEhjG/background-for-understanding-the-diffusion-of-large-language)
